author: reek
body: Reports the terrain model at chosen points. This is the model running, not a picture of it.

author: reek
body: The triplanar weights are printed on their own because they are the one quantity that is easy to get wrong and impossible to see in an image: a weight set that does not sum to one, or that favours the wrong axis on a wall, produces a picture that still looks textured.

author: reek
body: A flat surface must be pure top projection, a wall pure side. Both are asserted here rather than assumed, and the diagonal shows the blend is a blend and not a switch.
